sources.entry: Dictámelo - Voice dictation with downloadable local speech models, optional cloud providers and a configurable push-to-talk shortcut.

summary.one_liner: Dictámelo is a Rust and Taup 2 desktop app for macOS and Windows that transcribes speech on hold-to-talk and pastes the text at the cursor, using downloadable local models or optional cloud providers.
summary.what_it_does: Runs as a menu bar or system tray app with a configurable push-to-talk shortcut (default Alt/Option + Shift + Space). Holding the shortcut records speech, transcribes it, optionally cleans the text with an AI step, and pastes the result at the cursor while restoring the previous clipboard. Local speech models (Whisper Tiny, Base, Small, Large v3, Canary 180M Flash, Parakeet v3) can be downloaded and run on the computer. Personal-key mode works with Groq, OpenAI, Mistral or Deepgram, and an optional hosted Free Cloud or Pro plan uses a Supabase backend. It also transcribes audio files, keeps a local history, and has a UI in six languages.
use_cases: dictate text into any app by voice
offline speech-to-text on a Mac or Windows PC
push-to-talk voice typing with a custom shortcut
use my own Groq or OpenAI key for transcription
clean up dictated transcripts with an AI step
how_to_run: npm run dev # personal keys; cloud disabled by default
notable: Downloadable local speech models with verified downloads and offline transcription
Pastes at the cursor and restores the previous clipboard, including images and files
Personal-key mode works without any Dictámelo account
API keys and sessions stored in macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager, not plain files
Provider adapters are pluggable via TranscriptionProvider and TextCleaner
caveats: Windows cannot paste into administrator apps; text stays on the clipboard in that case, and the Windows decoder does not support AIFF/CAF
Windows installers lack a Microsoft Authenticode certificate, so SmartScreen may warn; Intel Macs and Linux installers are not provided
A clean source build uses personal keys only; hosted services and automatic updates are disabled, and cloud builds need a private config file
keywords: voice to text on my mac
